body: ## Last-Minute Moving Cleanout Tips ### Meta Description: Last-minute moving cleanouts can be overwhelming. Get expert advice on what to keep, what to donate, and what to dispose of with 1-800-GOT-JUNK?'s last-minute moving cleanout tips. ### Keywords: moving cleanout, last-minute moving, junk removal, decluttering, organization, home cleaning ### Introduction Are you in a panic about cleaning out your old home before your big move? Don't stress, we've got you covered with these last-minute moving cleanout tips. At 1-800-GOT-JUNK?, we've seen our fair share of messy moves, and we're here to help you tackle that clutter once and for all. ### Quick Decluttering Tips Before diving into the nitty-gritty of cleaning out your old home, let's start with some quick decluttering tips: - **Sort Items into Categories**: Divide your belongings into three piles: keep, donate/sell, and discard. Be ruthless – if you haven't used it in the past year, it's probably safe to get rid of it. - **Use the One-In-One-Out Rule**: For every new item you bring into your home, get rid of an old one. This will help maintain a balanced level of clutter. - **Don't Forget the Little Things**: Clean out kitchen drawers, bathroom cabinets, and closets – these often-overlooked areas can be a breeding ground for clutter. ### What to Keep and What to Donate It can be tough deciding what to keep and what to donate, but here are some general guidelines: - **Keep What Adds Value**: If an item holds sentimental value or serves a practical purpose, keep it. Consider keeping a few favorite pieces of art, a vintage collectible, or a family heirloom that's worth passing down. - **Donate What's Still Useable**: Consider donating gently used items that are still in good condition. This could include clothing, furniture, or household items that can be donated to local charities or thrift stores. - **Get Rid of What's Broken or Damaged**: Be honest with yourself – if an item is broken or damaged beyond repair, it's probably time to let it go. ### Disposing of Unsightly Items At 1-800-GOT-JUNK?, we specialize in disposing of unsightly items that other junk removal companies might shy away from. Here are some tips for getting rid of those pesky items: - **Appliances and Furniture**: Consider hiring a professional to dispose of large appliances and furniture.
